reviewBasis: Source-only pilot rubric at /tmp/vector-pilot-source-review.json; native rendered PNGs plus stable contact sheets. Visual assessment only: no ownership, albedo, or publication acceptance.
schemaLimitation: The current description schema has no explicit balcony feature. Missing balcony rails cannot be attributed solely to a model, but a useful arm must at least preserve the observed central recess/void and avoid replacing it with a solid regular window grid.

directSVG.note: No native PNG was produced; it cannot count as a usable arm.

structured.note: Best observed result for this source: preserves three separated rows and the broad-left/two-narrow-right rhythm, with a plausible dark-brown wall band. It still simplifies the double entrance and roof/trim, so needs correction before any use beyond coarse game geometry.

assisted.note: Restores the 3×3 opening count but makes the left openings too uniformly arched and alters row/band spacing; entrance remains overlarge and simplified.

directSVG.note: Closest GLM representation: preserves the broad cream-over-brick banding, repeated wings and a central stacked recess. It does not express rails/slabs, and its foreground triangles are unsupported facade geometry; retain only as a correction candidate.

structured.note: Turns the central balcony stack into a tall solid brown block and adds unsupported base polygons. Regular opening rows alone do not preserve the source layout.

assisted.note: Likewise substitutes a solid central field for the stacked recess and creates an unobserved regular ground row. This is a schema limitation plus an inadequate fallback, not a balcony acceptance.

directSVG.note: The only arm that roughly retains the photographed hierarchy of small top opening, middle pair and large arch. It invents circular/diagonal roof decoration and literal shrubs where lower foliage should remain unknown; not acceptable without correction.

structured.note: No native PNG was produced; not usable.

assisted.note: Misplaces the upper/middle openings and produces an unsupported oversized central form and lower geometry.

directSVG.note: No native PNG was produced; not usable.

structured.note: It captures repeated rows and broadly the left-plus-two-right opening pattern, but stretches the facade vertically and makes the ground entrance a pair of narrow red openings rather than the observed arched double entrance.

assisted.note: Count is close but all openings are too tall and uniformly arched. It is weaker than GLM structured for coarse geometry.

directSVG.note: Creates dense micro-window grids that do not align with the photographed bays or counts.

structured.note: Regularizes windows but fails to retain a central recess and adds unsupported base geometry.

assisted.note: Also removes the central stacked recess and makes a generic base; no coarse-game fit.

directSVG.note: Final native render shows the visible hierarchy of one small upper opening, a middle pair and a dominant arch more closely than the earlier contact implied. It still turns foliage-hidden ground into definite geometry and cannot be used without correction.

structured.note: Also approximates the visible one-plus-pair-plus-arch hierarchy, but omits the photographed roof/cornice complexity and makes the concealed lower field definite.

assisted.note: Keeps the broad arched opening but invents an extra upper split and solid lower treatment; correction candidate only.

directSVG.note: Merges the photographed four window rows into two extremely tall paired strips and invents a generic base. It misses the visible 11–12 opening rhythm.

structured.note: Best GLM arm here: it preserves four rows of three openings, brown brick and pale base/entrance separation. It over-regularizes the changing arch/trim treatment and simplifies the ground shop/recess, so needs correction.

assisted.note: Captures a 4×3 rhythm but regularizes different window-head treatments and ground detail into generic forms.

directSVG.note: Best arm: retains three bays, four observed vertical levels, two central balcony rail bands, buff-brown wall and a distinct ground entrance zone. Window proportions and lower vehicle-obscured edge still require correction.

structured.note: Erases the two observed balcony levels and substitutes uniform arched openings; this changes the visible facade structure.

assisted.note: Likewise replaces balcony structure with a regular opening grid and invents a simplified base/door arrangement.

directSVG.note: Preserves the visible broad yellow rendered field, grey base, central stacked curved balcony/recess stack and repeated wing-window layout. Edge truncation, exact opening count and lower parked-object detail remain unresolved; retain only as a correction candidate.

decision: GLM structured index 0 and 3, GLM direct index 4 and 11 are provisional coarse-only candidates needing correction. GLM direct index 17/30 and all MiMo 30 arms are correction candidates only. No output is fit for automated or source-authoritative publication.
